status: Empty by design. No authorized first-party report has been supplied.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.meaning: When the report row was obtained (UTC).

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: Named first-party report, e.g. Associates Reports export. Must be an official source.

columns.name: channel
columns.meaning: Where the traffic came from, e.g. guide page, product card.

columns.name: eligible_sessions
columns.meaning: Sessions reported as eligible, as given in the source report.

columns.name: clicks
columns.meaning: Clicks as given in the source report.

columns.name: reported_orders
columns.meaning: Orders as given in the source report. Never estimated.

columns.name: provenance_note
columns.meaning: File name, export date and who exported it.

rules: A row is added only from an authorized first-party report. No estimated rows.
No conversion score, revenue forecast or commission estimate is shown.
Each new row keeps a dated provenance note.
